title: Network Connectivity Repair
description: Diagnose Windows network issues with read-only adapter, DNS, route, and connectivity evidence before approved repairs or resets.
starter_prompt: Diagnose this PC's network connectivity problem. Start read-only and ask before resets.

phases.prompt: Confirm symptom, affected network, wired/wireless, VPN/proxy use, and when it started.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output '== Get-NetAdapter =='; Get-NetAdapter | Format-List Name,Status,InterfaceDescription,LinkSpeed,MacAddress; Write-Output '== Get-NetIPConfiguration =='; Get-NetIPConfiguration | Format-List; Write-Output '== DNS Servers =='; Get-DnsClientServerAddress | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output '== ipconfig /all =='; ipconfig /all; Write-Output '== route print =='; route print; Write-Output '== Recent network events =='; Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 200 | Where-Object { $_.ProviderName -match 'Tcpip|Dhcp|DNS Client Events|Netwtw|NetBT|WLAN-AutoConfig|NlaSvc' } | Select-Object TimeCreated,ProviderName,Id,LevelDisplayName,Message -First 40 | Format-List

phases.prompt: Run read-only commands: Get-NetAdapter, Get-NetIPConfiguration, Get-DnsClientServerAddress, ipconfig /all, route print, and recent network event logs.
phases.completion: Network state and logs are captured.

phases.prompt: Analyze adapter, DNS, gateway, DHCP, proxy, VPN, and event evidence. Identify likely cause and safest repair.

Ask for explicit approval before running any network repair (DNS cache flush and DHCP renew). Confirm the affected adapter and offer a restore point where appropriate. Do not proceed without positive approval.
phases.completion: Approval and restore point decision are recorded.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $failures=@(); Write-Output '== Flush DNS client cache =='; try { Clear-DnsClientCache } catch { $failures+=('Clear-DnsClientCache failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Output '== Renew DHCP leases =='; ipconfig /renew; $renewExit=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('ipconfig /renew exit code: ' + $renewExit); if ($renewExit -ne 0) { $failures+=('ipconfig /renew exit ' + $renewExit) }; if ($failures.Count -gt 0) { throw ('Targeted network repair failed: ' + ($failures -join '; ')) }; Write-Output 'Targeted network repair completed. A reboot may still be required if Winsock/VPN/filter drivers are involved.'

phases.prompt: After the approval gate succeeded, run only targeted low-risk network repair commands: DNS cache flush and DHCP renew. Fail the phase when either command reports an error or a non-zero exit code. Do not run Winsock reset or adapter disable automatically.
phases.completion: DNS flush and DHCP renew both completed, or the phase failed with the exact failing step and exit code.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output '== Adapter status =='; Get-NetAdapter | Format-Table Name,Status,LinkSpeed -AutoSize; Write-Output '== Gateway ping =='; $gw=(Get-NetIPConfiguration | Where-Object { $_.IPv4DefaultGateway } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty IPv4DefaultGateway).NextHop; if ($gw) { Test-Connection -ComputerName $gw -Count 2 } else { Write-Output 'No IPv4 gateway detected' }; Write-Output '== DNS resolve =='; Resolve-DnsName microsoft.com -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5 | Format-List; Write-Output '== HTTPS reachability =='; $https=Test-NetConnection www.microsoft.com -Port 443; $https | Format-List; if (-not $https.TcpTestSucceeded) { throw 'Connectivity verification failed: HTTPS endpoint www.microsoft.com:443 is not reachable after repair' }

phases.prompt: Verify adapter up, gateway reachable, DNS resolves, and internet endpoint reachable. Fail the phase when the internet endpoint is still unreachable after repair.
phases.completion: Connectivity is verified end-to-end, or the phase fails with the unreachable endpoint captured.

phases.prompt: Create a technician-readable network repair report with symptom, evidence, actions/tools used, repair steps, verification result, logs/artifacts, cleanup status, residual risk, rollback notes, and follow-up.
phases.completion: User has a clear handoff report.

phases.prompt: Preserve logs and report; remove only workflow-owned temporary scratch files.

acceptance_criteria: Read-only diagnostics were captured before repair.
Risky reset commands were approved before running.
Verification includes adapter, gateway, DNS, and endpoint checks.
Report lists commands run and rollback/follow-up guidance.
